subject: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
question: Solve (x − 1)² = 49.
response_text:
Taking the square root of both sides:
(x − 1)² = 49
x − 1 = 7
x = 8

Check: (8 − 1)² = 7² = 49, so x = 8 is the solution.
